loading._comment: Arms: [FM] V.2 / FAA TCDS G39EU, seat 1 1150 mm in front of the datum, seat 2 40 mm behind; datum = wing root leading edge = body x 0. Max seat loads 110 kg, baggage 10 kg, trim ballast 5.6 kg in the front cockpit when the front pilot is under 70 kg ([FM] II.8). CG range 260-460 mm aft of datum = 24.7-43.6 % MAC. Eye points are derived, not published (derivation sec. 7).
